before: Table column insertion and deletion had no tracked form. Original and No Markup views ignored table, row, and cell property records and cell insertions and deletions.
after: insertTableColumn and deleteTableColumn accept revision attribution (and widthTwips for a tracked insertion). They write existing Word cellIns, cellDel, tcPrChange, tblGridChange, and tblPrChange markup that existing review decisions resolve. Resolved views project those records and omit proposed or deleted cells.
reason: New optional local operation fields lower to existing canonical primitive edits; the shared journal and transport carry no new field. Views are local projections. Holders created for histories use mark-family IDs locally; replicas keep an emptied holder, which converges.
